questionEn: Which of the following corresponds to the material in the paragraph “Practical lesson”?
questionUz: Quyidagilardan qaysi biri “Amaliy dars” bandidagi materialga mos keladi?
choicesEn: Side to the neck with a match with the gas valve open
Directly into the gas flow from above
choicesUz: Ochiq gaz klapan bilan gugurt bilan bo'yniga yon tomonda
explanationEn: Bring the match to the side - otherwise the flow will extinguish the flame.
explanationUz: Gugurtni yon tomonga olib keling - aks holda oqim olovni o'chiradi.
